description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling the ResetConnectionMetrics command within a messaging persistence context. It extends an abstract strategy class and defines specific response and actions to be performed when the command is received.

classes.name: ResetConnectionMetricsStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractEphemeralStrategy to handle ResetConnectionMetrics commands by generating an appropriate response and performing defined connection actions.
